name: Matt Muir
biography: Matt is a security researcher with a passion for UNIX and UNIX-like operating systems. He previously worked as a macOS malware analyst and his background includes experience in the areas of digital forensics, DevOps, and operational cyber security. Matt enjoys technical writing and has published research including the discovery of the first malware family to target AWS Lambda, emerging cloud-focused botnets, and a series of novel Linux malware campaigns.
